prompt: Our engineering team includes foreign national employees. When does showing them ITAR technical data become a problem?
assertions: Defines the deemed export rule: releasing ITAR technical data to a foreign person in the US is an export to their country/countries of nationality
States a license/authorization (e.g., DSP-5) is required unless an exemption applies, judged as if exporting to that nationality
Covers what counts as release: visual access, oral disclosure, physical access to hardware revealing technical data, IT system access
Recommends a Technology Control Plan: access controls, segregated systems, badging/escort, training, screening of nationalities against §126.1
Notes dual/third nationalities considerations and that US persons include green-card holders (foreign person = not US citizen/permanent resident/protected person)
